raw_resume.summary: Software Engineer with 3+ years of professional experience building scalable Java and Spring Boot microservices in fintech. Seeking the Software Engineer II role at Google Cloud, with expertise in system design, code review, and distributed systems architecture.

bullets: Reduced p95 latency of the settlement API from 800 ms to 350 ms by adding Redis caching.
Split the monolithic payouts module into 4 Spring Boot microservices communicating over REST.
Mentored 2 junior engineers and conducted code reviews in 2-week Agile sprints.
Implemented JPA/Hibernate repositories and MySQL schema changes for the merchant onboarding service.
Automated nightly reconciliation reports, saving the operations team 6 hours per week.

profile_improvement_tips: Learn Python or JavaScript to match the JD's primary language requirements; your Java expertise is strong, but multi-language fluency is valued at Google.
Gain hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Pub/Sub to directly align with the role.
Deepen your system design knowledge by studying distributed systems patterns (consensus, sharding, replication) and documenting a design case study in your portfolio.
raw_resume.growth_note: You have strong Java and microservices experience, but the JD emphasises Python, JavaScript, and C++ as primary languages, and GCP as the platform. Your fintech backend work demonstrates system thinking, but you lack explicit exposure to the languages and cloud platform Google prioritises. Consider building a GCP project in Python or JavaScript to bridge this gap.
